meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 会在你要求审查已完成的工作时,并行启动 5 个后台助手,分别检查目标、代码质量、安全性、运行效果,并从 GitHub、git、Slack 等处收集背景。全部通过才算过,任一不合格则整体失败。产出各助手的判定与最终通过/失败结论。
howto.when: 在提交 PR 前,或当你明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。触发说法包括 'review work'、'review my work'、'review changes' 等。

say.note: 5 个后台助手并行检查,全部通过才算过。

say.text: 帮我检查代码改动,为 PR 提交做准备。
say.note: 会在提交 PR 前启动完整审查。

say.text: 验证这个实现是否按需求做好了。
say.note: 重点核对目标、约束与运行效果。

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude launches 5 parallel background agents for goal, code quality, security, hands-on QA, and context mining (GitHub/git/Slack). All must pass; any fail fails review. Outputs each verdict and overall pass/fail.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff or when you explicitly ask to review finished work. Common trigger phrases: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', etc.

say_en.text: Check my code changes before I submit the PR.
Verify this implementation meets the requirements.
say_en.note: Checks goals, constraints, and runtime behavior.
